hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --fix "$f" >/dev/null; ./node_modules/.bin/biome check --write "$f";; *.json|*.jsonc|*.css) ./node_modules/.bin/biome check --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
